main_text.p: *קפא Ch. Saltare, subsilire. Idem quod קפץ.

פַּהֵל קפּח Pahel Syriac. Colaphum impingere, vel infligere, colaphis percutere, caedere, 2. ad Corinth. 12. 7. Matt. 26. 67. Hinc Ch. וּבִמְרְבְּרָא בִיִּמְמָא קְפָחִין Et in deserto interdiu caedes & latrocinia exercent, ut Tremellius transfert, Hos. 7. 1. Reg. Graffantur, nempe ad occidendos homines. Ex Ithpahel Partic. ... Colaphis caedimur, 1. ad Cor. 4. 11.
Pahel Ch. Duplicare, complicare, Num. 10. 35. 36. in Targ Jon. Convenit cum כפל.
קפלוס Ch. Porrum, cepa, herba capitata, sic dicta à Gr. κεφαλή, Caput, ut & monet author Aruch parvi. Pl. קפלויא, Numer. 11. 5. in Jon.
קופָּא Ch. Κάψα, capsa, arca, cista, Deut. 31. 26. in Jon. Syr. Domus capsae, Apotheca, repositorium frumenti, horreum, Luc. 12. 24. Pl.
Ibid. v. 18. Vide Notas D. Tremell. & Junii. Hinc verbum,
Syr. In arcam aut feretrum collegit, impo-suit, Act. 5. 10. & 8. 2.
קפּוּפָא Chald. Noctua, avis immundae nomen. Plural. קפופין. Convenit Graec. Κέκφος, itidem nomen avis.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek words are rendered as closely as the scan allows; the vocalised Hebrew and Syriac forms are approximate. Several Syriac lines are partly illegible and are given as best read. The lines marked "..." in the Pahel entry are Syriac script that could not be read reliably.
